report.summary: Chunk 4 of 10: defines council_env, council_cwd, run_managed, CouncilProfile, FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS. Claims about stripping OLLAMA_HOST, tempdir outside repo, stdin file vs pipe, process tree kill, no prompt in args, forbidden fragments are checked.
risks: council_env | medium | 'Never set, never mutated, never inherited' is uncheckable: no code in chunk proves env is not set/mutated/inherited elsewhere. | Check if any caller modifies returned dict or passes it to mutating functions.

council_cwd | medium | 'Raises if system temp dir sits under repo_root' is tested only for equality and parent relationship; symlink resolution may be incomplete. | Verify that symlinks in temp path are resolved to avoid false positives/negatives.

run_managed | critical | 'THE PROMPT IS NEVER IN argv' is a claim about all callers; this chunk only implements the function, not the callers. | Audit all callers of run_managed to ensure they never pass prompt in argv.

run_managed | high | 'The whole process TREE dies on timeout' depends on ManagedProcess.cancel() killing the tree; this chunk does not show that implementation. | Review ManagedProcess.cancel() to confirm it kills the process group/tree.

run_managed | medium | 'Popen.terminate reaches immediate child only' is a general statement; the code uses ManagedProcess, not Popen, so the claim is about an alternative not used here. | No action needed if ManagedProcess handles tree kill; otherwise, update docstring.
CouncilProfile | low | 'stdin_prompt is always true here' is enforced by test, not by code; this chunk does not include the test. | Add a runtime check or rely on test coverage.

FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS | low | 'Forbidden anywhere in a council argv' is a convention; no validation code in this chunk enforces it. | Add validation in the runner or document that callers must filter.

handoff.purpose: Define environment preparation, temporary directory creation, process runner, runner profile dataclass, and forbidden argument fragments.

symbols.name: council_env
symbols.note: Returns a copy of environment with OLLAMA_HOST removed. Base can be None to use os.environ.

symbols.name: council_cwd
symbols.note: Creates a temporary directory, verifies it is not under repo_root, returns context manager.

symbols.name: run_managed
symbols.note: Spawns a subprocess via ManagedProcess with stdin from file, timeout, tree kill. Returns RunResult.

symbols.name: CouncilProfile
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for vendor CLI invocation; stdin_prompt always True.

symbols.name: FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS
symbols.note: Tuple of strings forbidden in council argv.

claims.text: Environment for a council subprocess, with ``OLLAMA_HOST`` STRIPPED.
Never set, never mutated, never inherited -- see the module docstring.
claims.why: The code only returns a dict; no enforcement of immutability or inheritance is shown in this chunk.

claims.text: A council that normalises a remote Ollama into a shared environment silently invalidates ``offload.py``'s trusted-lane justification repo-wide.
claims.why: Reference to offload.py not present in this chunk.

claims.text: A fresh, EMPTY temp directory to spawn a council subprocess in.
claims.why: Function creates a new TemporaryDirectory with prefix 'dcouncil-cwd-'.

claims.text: Raises if the system temp dir somehow sits under ``repo_root``
claims.why: Code checks if root == here or root in here.parents and raises ValueError.

claims.text: THE PROMPT IS NEVER IN ``argv``. It is staged to a temp file and handed over as the child's stdin.
claims.why: Function writes stdin_text to a temp file and passes that file as stdin; argv is passed as-is.

claims.text: A file rather than a pipe because a CLI that never drains stdin deadlocks the writer OUTSIDE every timeout -- and because on the ssh path a command-line prompt is re-parsed by the remote login shell, which turns any backtick or ``$(...)`` in a diff into remote code execution with no adversarial model required.
claims.why: Justification for using file vs pipe is not verifiable from this code; it's a design rationale.

claims.text: The whole process TREE dies on timeout.
claims.why: The function calls proc.cancel() on timeout, but the implementation of ManagedProcess.cancel() is not in this chunk.

claims.text: ``Popen.terminate`` reaches the immediate child only; a hung vendor's grandchildren outlive it.
claims.why: This is a general claim about Popen.terminate, not about the actual ManagedProcess used here.

claims.text: ``args`` never contains the prompt: :attr:`stdin_prompt` is always true here and the shape is enforced by test, not by convention.
claims.why: No validation in this chunk; relies on external tests.

claims.text: Forbidden anywhere in a council argv.  ``workspace-write`` and ``dontAsk`` are the two flags that turn a reviewer into an agent with an editor.
claims.why: No enforcement code in this chunk; it's a declaration of forbidden strings.

observations.what: council_env returns a mutable dict; docstring claims it is never mutated but no immutability enforced.
council_cwd checks for temp dir under repo_root but does not handle symlinks in the path beyond resolve().
run_managed uses ManagedProcess and relies on its cancel() for tree kill; not verifiable in this chunk.
run_managed catches FileNotFoundError and CancellationUnavailable/OSError; spawn_error field in RunResult is not defined in this chunk.
FORBIDDEN_ARG_FRAGMENTS is defined but not used in this chunk; no validation in run_managed or CouncilProfile.
